bullet: Log order is timestamp order (`F06.search-timestamp-order`), known bug.
script:
OBS_ID=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/search" \
  --query kind=openhands.sdk.event.llm_convertible.observation.ObservationEvent --check items len-ge 1 --field items.0.id)
OBS_T=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/$OBS_ID" --check id eq "$OBS_ID" --field timestamp)
FROM_OBS=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/search" --field items \
  | jq -e --arg id "$OBS_ID" '[.[].id] | length - index($id)')
test "$FROM_OBS" -ge 2
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/count" --query timestamp__gte="$OBS_T" \
  --check . ge "$FROM_OBS" --save F06.search-timestamp-order/count-since-observation  # bug
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/events/$LIVE" --query resend_mode=since --query after_timestamp="$OBS_T" \
  --duration 3 --save F06.search-timestamp-order/replay-since-observation | jq -e --argjson n "$FROM_OBS" '.frames - 1 >= $n'  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/search" --field items | jq -e '[.[].timestamp] | . == sort'  # bug
